FRAGO 001 TO OPORD PACIFIC STRATEGY AY26
DTG: 091200ZMAR26
REF: OPORD PACIFIC STRATEGY AY26, DTG 010600ZMAR26

1. SITUATION: PLA EASTERN THEATER COMMAND HAS INTENSIFIED NAVAL ACTIVITY IN TAIWAN STRAIT. INTELLIGENCE INDICATES INCREASED SUBMARINE DEPLOYMENTS AND SURFACE ACTION GROUP MOVEMENTS SOUTH OF MIYAKO STRAIT.

2. MISSION: CJTF-WESTPAC SHIFTS MAIN EFFORT FROM DETERRENCE POSTURE TO ACTIVE MARITIME INTERDICTION OPERATIONS IN THE TAIWAN STRAIT AND APPROACHES. EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY.

3. EXECUTION:
   a. CONCEPT OF OPERATIONS: ESTABLISH MARITIME INTERDICTION ZONE (MIZ) IN TAIWAN STRAIT. COORDINATE WITH 7TH FLEET FOR SURFACE PICKET LINE. 5TH AIR FORCE PROVIDES AIR SUPERIORITY UMBRELLA.
   b. TASKS TO SUBORDINATE UNITS:
      (1) 7TH FLEET: ESTABLISH SURFACE ACTION GROUP IN NORTHERN TAIWAN STRAIT
      (2) STRIKE PACKAGE ALPHA: MAINTAIN 2-HOUR ALERT STATUS FOR PRECISION STRIKE
      (3) 3RD MEF ARG: REPOSITION TO SUPPORT MARITIME INTERDICTION
   c. COORDINATING INSTRUCTIONS: ROE PER SEPARATE FRAGO 002.

4. SUSTAINMENT: NO CHANGE FROM BASE OPORD.

5. COMMAND AND SIGNAL: NO CHANGE.

FRAGO 002 TO OPORD PACIFIC STRATEGY AY26
DTG: 091400ZMAR26
REF: OPORD PACIFIC STRATEGY AY26, DTG 010600ZMAR26; FRAGO 001

1. SITUATION: NO CHANGE.

2. MISSION: NO CHANGE.

3. EXECUTION:
   a. ROE UPDATE: WEAPONS HOLD IN LUZON STRAIT EFFECTIVE IMMEDIATELY.
      (1) ALL UNITS OPERATING IN LUZON STRAIT AREA (BOUNDING: 18N-21N, 120E-122E) WILL ADOPT WEAPONS HOLD POSTURE.
      (2) ENGAGEMENT AUTHORIZED ONLY IN SELF-DEFENSE OR WITH EXPLICIT AUTHORIZATION FROM CJTF-WESTPAC.
      (3) EXCEPTION: SUBMARINE CONTACTS DEMONSTRATING HOSTILE INTENT PER STANDING ROE REMAIN VALID.
   b. REASON: DIPLOMATIC NEGOTIATIONS IN PROGRESS WITH PRC REGARDING FREEDOM OF NAVIGATION IN LUZON STRAIT.
   c. DURATION: UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE OR SUPERSEDED BY SUBSEQUENT FRAGO.

4. SUSTAINMENT: NO CHANGE.

5. COMMAND AND SIGNAL: REPORT COMPLIANCE WITHIN 2 HOURS OF RECEIPT.

FRAGO 003 TO OPORD CJTF-WESTPAC STRIKE OPS
DTG: 091600ZMAR26
REF: OPORD CJTF-WESTPAC, DTG 020800ZMAR26; FRAGO 001 (INDOPACOM)

1. SITUATION: IAW INDOPACOM FRAGO 001, MAIN EFFORT SHIFTS TO MARITIME INTERDICTION.

2. MISSION: NO CHANGE TO MISSION STATEMENT. PRIORITY ADJUSTMENT REQUIRED.

3. EXECUTION:
   a. CONCEPT: REPRIORITIZE LOGISTICS SUPPORT TO MARITIME INTERDICTION OPS.
   b. TASKS:
      (1) STRIKE PACKAGE ALPHA: PRIORITY OF FIRES SHIFTS TO ANTI-SHIP CRUISE MISSILE (ASCM) COVERAGE OF MIZ.
      (2) LOGISTICS CONVOY BRAVO: DIVERT 60% OF FUEL ALLOCATION TO 7TH FLEET SURFACE COMBATANTS.
   c. COORDINATING INSTRUCTIONS: COORDINATE FUEL PRIORITIES WITH N4/G4.

4. SUSTAINMENT:
   a. LOGISTICS PRIORITY SHIFT: MARITIME INTERDICTION OPS RECEIVE PRIORITY OF SUPPORT.
   b. FUEL: REALLOCATE JP-5 STOCKS TO SUPPORT INCREASED NAVAL OPERATIONS TEMPO.
   c. ORDNANCE: INCREASE ASCM (LRASM/HARPOON) ALLOCATION TO STRIKE ASSETS.

5. COMMAND AND SIGNAL: NO CHANGE.
